title: Leaving Pontotoc for Thanksgiving? Tuesday morning offers a drier start than Wednesday
excerpt: AAA’s national outlook favors leaving before 1 p.m. Tuesday. In Pontotoc County, rain is likely after midnight Tuesday night and the chance reaches 90% Wednesday.
locality: Pontotoc County, Mississippi, with national holiday traffic estimates identified separately.

paragraphs.text: For Pontotoc County drivers with a choice of departure days, Tuesday morning offers mostly sunny weather before the Thanksgiving traffic rush. AAA’s national outlook favors leaving before 1 p.m. Tuesday. By Wednesday, the National Weather Service expects showers in Pontotoc County, with a 90% chance of rain.

The county forecast calls for a high in the upper 50s Tuesday. Showers become likely after midnight Tuesday night, with a 70% rain chance. Wednesday’s high should stay in the lower 50s. The chance of showers falls to 50% Wednesday evening, and Thanksgiving Day is forecast to be mostly sunny.

INRIX, which prepared the traffic estimates for AAA, lists Tuesday from 2 to 8 p.m. and Wednesday from noon to 7 p.m. as the busiest driving windows on those days. For return trips it favors leaving before 11 a.m. Sunday or before 1 p.m. Monday. Those are nationwide planning estimates. Conditions on an individual Mississippi highway can differ.

For the trip itself, the Mississippi Department of Transportation’s traffic map shows current road conditions and construction zones. Travelers can also look at highway cameras or sign up for traffic alerts for their route.
